cpmplus.animimport.menu.desc: Brings animations of another file into the open model, on the parts both have.
cpmplus.animimport.title: Import animations
cpmplus.animimport.intro: %s: %s of %s animated parts of that file exist in your model (by CPM id or the same folder path). The keys of the others are left out. One Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.animimport.unmatched: Parts of that file that your model does not have (their keys were left out): %s
